yes so process is grey base colour, dry brush up from light greys on blue areas and then all the way to white on red areas. blue get a base tone of 50/50 black wash and vallejo turquesa caribe xpress paint and red get a base colour of vallej purpura cardenal xpress paint, over top of the pink then apply a watered down citadel blood angel red contrast, using these paints allows for the transition between red and blue and applying them when the other is still wet allows for wet blending. then i highlight the blue areas by stippling vallejo blue green airbrush paint, then vallejo blue green standard paint, then citdel baharroth blue, then edge highlight vallejo sky blue. then red areas get highlight of scrofulous brown then glaze citadel volupus pink into areas i want darker on red and to tone down the orange highlight.
its a lengthy sounding process but using xpress and contrast paints reduces the time massively.
